stories.title: Multi-turn chat threads
acceptance: Threads persist per room in localStorage
Rename, pin, archive supported
Export thread as JSON, Markdown, HTML
Submit sends full conversation history to the grid

stories.title: System prompts & presets
acceptance: Built-in presets with system prompt + sampler defaults
Custom presets savable/deletable
Selecting a preset applies system prompt and sampler defaults

stories.title: Sampler control panel
acceptance: UI for temperature, top-p, top-k, max tokens, seed, stop sequences
Options flow through runPrompt into pipe GenOptions / sampling

stories.title: Structured / JSON output mode
acceptance: Toggle for JSON mode with optional schema
System instruction injected when JSON mode is on
Assistant bubbles attempt to pretty-print valid JSON

stories.title: Streaming UX upgrades
acceptance: Token stream renders as markdown
Fenced code blocks have a copy button
Thinking/reasoning blocks (<think> or similar) are collapsible

stories.title: Downloadable Electron desktop app
acceptance: desktop/ Electron shell loads the static Next export
WebGPU flags enabled for Chromium
pnpm desktop:pack produces Linux artifacts
GitHub Actions release workflow on v* tags
README documents download/run
